mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (email, password, name, phone_number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phoneNumber}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT mem.member_id, mem.email, mem.name, mem.nickname, mem.phone_number, case when gender = 'M' then '남' when gender = 'F' then '여' ELSE '기타' END as gender , mem.date_of_birth, mem.status, rol.role_name FROM planer_db.members mem join roles rol on mem.role_id=rol.role_id ORDER BY mem.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET email = #{email}, password = #{password}, name = #{name}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM members WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM members WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
